retrievalProfile.description: A 1950s-style studio portrait of a male musician with an acoustic guitar, featuring high-contrast slab serif typography and a textured color-gradient background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central studio portrait of a smiling male musician seated with an acoustic guitar, set against a multi-tonal blue and orange gradient background with visible halftone grain. The layout is framed by a black border with bold, blocky typography at the top and a small branding bar at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The musician's head is positioned just below the primary title text
The guitar body provides a warm orange counterpoint to the cool blue background
The shadow cast to the right creates a sense of shallow studio depth
The secondary text is right-aligned to balance the guitar's neck extension

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician is centered, occupying the middle 70% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright orange acoustic guitar body in the lower-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large white title, moves down to the musician's face, follows the guitar neck down-right, and ends at the bottom branding bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight composition with minimal negative space, filled by the textured gradient and cast shadow.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and indigo background tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the primary title text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow and warm orange in the guitar and secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones against a desaturated, dark background to create pop.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to primary CMYK-adjacent tones to mimic vintage offset printing.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Square serifs on the primary title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same slab serif family to maintain mid-century cohesion.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure of the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a 1950s male musician with dark hair and a patterned shirt, holding an acoustic guitar. Use a background gradient of deep blue to orange with a heavy halftone print texture and a cast shadow to the right. Frame the entire image with a thick black border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in white extra-bold slab serif at the top. Add the artist name in golden yellow bold slab serif, right-aligned in the upper right quadrant. Place a small black rectangle at the bottom center with yellow serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the title in a heavy slab serif?
Is there a halftone texture over the image?
Is the musician holding an acoustic guitar?
Is the color palette dominated by blue, orange, and yellow?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the halftone texture is visible but does not obscure the face.
Check that the slab serifs are thick and blocky.
Verify the black border frames the entire composition.
Confirm the guitar color matches the warm accents in the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: 1950s Studio Portrait + Slab Serif Header + Halftone Texture + Black Frame Border
